test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Eight girls X, Y, Z, U, V, W, S and T are sitting around a circular table, facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). X is second to the left of U. U is third to the left of V. Z is third to the right of S. S is not the immediate neighbour of V. T is third to the right of Y. Y is second to the right of S. Three out of the following four options are similar by a certain logic and form a group. Which of the following does NOT belong to that group?
solution:
Given: Eight girls X, Y, Z, U, V, W, S and T.

1) X is second to the left of U. 

2) U is third to the left of V. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d3fb6cc0ac4bfe5e6f5c424347698153dcafc30580f1f0f9d2c368263738e96.png] 

3) S is not the immediate neighbor of V.

4) Z is third to the right of S. 

5) Y is second to the right of S.
